title: Pocket Watches
description: Funny little CIT-Based pack that adds pocket watchs
body:
This is a CIT Based pack, you will reqiure atleast one CIT Mod, ones this mod is tested on is Variants-CIT, CIT Resewn, And CIT Reforged.

Variants CIT is the Recommended mod to use but the others are for loader and version compatablility

Optifine might work but its untested

Adds 2 item textures that can be put over Clocks

"Stopwatch"

![pocketwatchimage](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3953873455e428256879794149036381aa7c025d_0.webp)

Custom Stopwatch Item Command 
```
give @p clock[custom_name='["",{"text":"Stopwatch","italic":false}]',lore=['["",{"text":"Tells the time, not much more to that","italic":false,"color":"white"}]']]
```

"Gilded Pocketwatch"

![gildedpocketwatchimage](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/81049cea78f0884c117293a8af9c5089a4754d30_0.webp)

Custom Gilded Pocketwach Item Command
```
give @p clock[custom_name='["",{"text":"Gilded Pocketwatch","italic":false,"color":"#ffcc00"}]',lore=['["",{"text":"A Gift for Your Patience","italic":false,"color":"#ffcc33"}]']]
```
